title: The FR-40 freeze regeneration in fe0c6b9 is proven score-neutral
body:
Why: t-k2mg5t6 (fe0c6b9, #668) edited scripts/boundaries.ts and regenerated evals/fr40/manifest.json and scorer-imports.json with freeze.ts --write; the freeze exists so the FR-40 verdict stays comparable, and no run checked that the scorer output is unchanged.
Outcome: the FR-40 scorer gives the same scores on the frozen units before and after fe0c6b9, or the freeze change is reverted and boundaries layered without touching the scorer import graph.
Proof: scorer run on frozen units at fe0c6b9^ and fe0c6b9 with identical output (diff empty).
Scope: evals/fr40/, scripts/boundaries.ts, test/evals/.
